notes.title: 🕊️ Discover your Next Adventure: Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy 🛩️
notes.content:
Bonjour Detectives,

On [b]April 24th[/b], answer the call of exploration and set off for [b][i]Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy[/i][/b]!

Embark on the quest of a lifetime aboard the Hydrafloat and explore a forgotten Latin American country to fulfill the last wishes of a late explorer. Make use of your curiosity and observational skills to solve intricate puzzles and bring back the White Birds into this mysterious land.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2429190/ss_87d5dc855bac62459ab5c7900c478a5b8c1f9620.1920x1080.jpg?t=1741885639[/img]

Released in 1999, [i]Amerzone[/i] had a great impact on the adventure genre and was ahead of its time with its ecological message. This game was also the first one Benoît Sokal created before the [i][b]Syberia[/b][/i] saga.

notes.title: Patch Notes: build ID - 12653720
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has played [i]Agatha Christie – Hercule Poirot: The London Case[/i] and to those who have provided feedback. We have been putting our Little Grey Cells to work to address bugs and issues since launch and we’re pleased to announce a new patch, which is now available for download (build ID – 12653720). 

This patch includes the following updates: 

[list] [*] Increased walk speed for Poirot in the Museum’s Main Hall, Theatre Street, and the Church 
[*] Resolved intermittent issue with missing ambient sounds and footsteps
[*] Missing German VO for Evelyn in Chapter 3 has been added  
[*] German Text and VO mismatch has been corrected
[*] German and French voice cast have been added to the end game credits
[*] Missing glass prop during “champagne incident” cutscene in Chapter 1 has been added[/list]
If you find any bugs or experience technical issues related to the game, don't hesitate to mention it in Steam discussions, or email our support team at [url=support@blazinggriffin.com]support@blazinggriffin.com[/url]. 

Don’t forget to also follow us [url=https://twitter.com/blazingggames]on X[/url] for updates about the famous Detective Poirot’s early career, as well as more titles on the horizon. 

Thank you, 

The Blazing Griffin Games Team

notes.title: Hercule Poirot: The London Case is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978131/90fae63b106457fe6e998ddebb765a787335f50d.png[/img]

As Hercule Poirot travels to London for the seemingly simple task of delivering a painting for an exhibition, things take a turn for the worse when said painting suddenly disappears. With the help of a young Arthur Hastings, Poirot will have to search the big city of London for clues to solve this new mystery.

[h3][u]Key features:[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Continue the journey in the Award-winning saga with the second episode, set in London.
[*] Discover iconic locations in London as you play as the famous detective Hercule Poirot and experience the thrill of being a detective and solve the mystery with investigation features such as interviewing suspects and collecting evidence.
[*] Immerse yourself in a dedicated original story, with fully voiced characters in English, French, and German.
[*] A script faithful to the Agatha Christie's original material, as you uncover the story and characters of Poirot's youth.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978131/262f8542e29bafdfd859a23592b56f2cf56ee122.png[/img]

[b]A brand-new mystery[/b]

[list]
[*] Written by Blazing Griffin Studio comes a gripping new adventure for Poirot with a whole new cast of characters to challenge the great detective.
[/list]

[b]Witnesses and Suspect Interrogations[/b]

[list]
[*] Solve mysteries and challenge suspects using the new match puzzle system to spot inconsistencies on the spot.
[/list]

[b]Environment and Item Inspection[/b]

[list]
[*] Explore all new environments and get up close with new first person inspection puzzles for a more cinematic view of the scenes.
[/list]

[b]Mindmaps and Character Profiles[/b]

[list]
[*] The game’s trademark mindmaps return allowing you to ese Poirot’s famous little grey cells to build challenging mindmaps and then draw the correct links that can solve the case.
[*] 
[*] The same now applies to the various suspects as Poirot gathers facts and information about each one to build detailed character profiles, key to solving the case and finding the true criminal among them.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978131/ce37ce440eaf446d664d3920a7ee8c1d03cd002a.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy our game!

- Microids & Blazing Griffin <3
